title: “I Am a Victim” Is Not Enough Without Bank Proof: SAFEMA Tribunal Upholds PMLA Attachment
description: SAFEMA Tribunal upholds ₹8.28 lakh PMLA attachment as appellant withheld bank statement and failed to establish bona fide receipt of funds.The post “I Am a Victim” Is Not Enough Without Bank Proof: SAFEMA Tribunal Upholds PMLA Attachment appeared first on TaxGuru.
